F.O.R MSF etc.] at consignee destination and all taxes like GST/IGST etc. separately. (iv)The items should have standard Guarantee/Warranty for period of 01 year / 12 months from the d ate of final acceptance. In case of defective Stores which need to be re-supplied To & Fro freight, insuranc e charges if any required for replacement have to be paid by the seller. Warranty calls needs to be attend ed within 07 days. The guarantee/warranty period would be extended by equivalent period for which the material is not available for the repaired parts, which were repaired & replaced during the Warranty period. (v) Participating firms must submit a declaration duly filled, signed & stamped (as per attached format), th at they comply with all terms and conditions of GeM Bid. (vi) Firm shall provide Test Certificate (T.C) of OEM [YIL SPM 2024 para 2.4(i) (Pg. 21)] along with the s upply of store. This clause will supersede other PSD related c lauses in the bid documents. (x) All other Terms & Conditions are as per YILSPM - 2024.
